title: SANParks rest camps & lodges
description: Official reservations for South African National Parks — rest camps, bungalows, and wilderness camps across Kruger, Addo, Garden Route, and more.
planningTip: Peak season (June–July, December) fills months ahead — book Kruger camps early or consider private concessions on park borders.

title: Namibia Wildlife Resorts
description: Government-run camps and lodges inside Namibia's flagship parks — Etosha waterholes, Sesriem (Sossusvlei gateway), and coastal reserves.
planningTip: July–October dry season is busiest at Etosha — reserve waterhole camps well in advance.

title: Zambia National Parks accommodation
description: Park fees and lodge guidance for Zambia's major reserves — South Luangwa walking safaris, Kafue bushcamps, and Lower Zambezi canoe trails.
planningTip: Many Luangwa lodges are outside the park gate — compare operator websites with park entry fees separately.

title: Zimbabwe Parks & Wildlife Authority
description: Official park accommodation and fee information for Hwange, Mana Pools, Matobo, and Victoria Falls National Park.
planningTip: Victoria Falls and some park fees are often paid in USD cash — carry small notes for gates.

title: ANAC conservation area permits
description: National Administration of Conservation Areas — permits and lodge guidance for Gorongosa, Bazaruto Archipelago, and mainland reserves.
planningTip: Island lodges in Bazaruto often arrange boat transfers — confirm visa status before travel.

title: Malawi Department of National Parks
description: Park fees and accommodation guidance for Liwonde, Nyika Plateau, and Lake Malawi National Park campsites.
planningTip: Lake Malawi park fees and Liwonde boat safaris are often arranged through lodges on arrival.

title: Lesotho nature reserves & parks
description: Forestry and park accommodation in the Kingdom in the Sky — high-altitude reserves and Sani Pass gateway lodges.
planningTip: Entry is almost always via South Africa — confirm your SA visa allows re-entry after visiting Lesotho.

title: Big Game Parks reserves
description: Central booking for Eswatini's flagship reserves — Hlane Royal National Park, Mkhaya rhino sanctuary, and Mlilwane Wildlife Sanctuary.
planningTip: Hlane and Mkhaya are run by Big Game Parks — book through their Ezulwini office for best availability.

title: Botswana park & lodge planning
description: Official guidance on park fees, mobile safaris, and lodge booking in the Okavango Delta and Chobe — most camps book through Maun and Kasane operators.
planningTip: Okavango fly-in camps and Moremi public camps have limited sites — compare Maun operators vs mobile safari outfits.

title: South Africa Tourism — plan your trip
description: Official destination portal with links to provincial tourism boards, registered guides, and activity providers across all nine provinces.
planningTip: For Kruger, compare SANParks self-drive with private reserve operators on the park boundary — different rules and costs.

title: Namibia Tourism Board
description: Official operator and activity directory — self-drive routes, community conservancy lodges, and licensed safari guides.
planningTip: Community conservancies in Damaraland and Kaokoland offer unique stays — book through conservancy offices or NTB-listed operators.

title: Botswana Tourism — licensed operators
description: Official directory of licensed safari operators, Delta camps, and Chobe River cruise providers — book directly with registered companies.
planningTip: Verify operator registration with Botswana Tourism before paying deposits — Okavango fly-in camps require advance booking.

title: Zambia Tourism Agency
description: Official activity and operator listings — Victoria Falls adventures, South Luangwa walking safari specialists, and Lower Zambezi canoe operators.
planningTip: KAZA UniVisa (USD 50) covers Zambia and Zimbabwe for Victoria Falls circuits — confirm eligibility for your passport.

title: Zimbabwe Tourism Authority
description: Registered tour operators and activity providers — Victoria Falls rafting and helicopter flights, Hwange safari operators, Mana Pools canoe safaris.
planningTip: Mana Pools walking safaris require licensed guides — book through ZTA-listed operators with park permits.

title: Visit Mozambique — tours & diving
region: Maputo, Tofo, Bazaruto, Ilha de Moçambique
description: Official tourism portal with registered operators — Tofo whale shark diving, Bazaruto island transfers, and Maputo cultural walking tours.
planningTip: Most visitors need a visa — apply via the e-visa portal before travel when possible.

title: Malawi Tourism — community & lake
description: Licensed operators for Lake Malawi kayaking, Liwonde boat safaris, Mount Mulanje trekking guides, and community homestay programmes.
planningTip: Community tourism villages around Cape Maclear and Nkhata Bay offer homestays — book through official Malawi Tourism listings.

title: Visit Lesotho — pony trekking & adventure
description: Registered pony trekking outfits, Sani Pass 4x4 guides, and Malealea community lodge operators in the Kingdom in the Sky.
planningTip: Sani Pass requires a 4x4 and experienced driver — several licensed operators run return trips from Underberg (South Africa).

title: Eswatini Tourism — culture & wildlife
description: Official operator directory — Mantenga Cultural Village tours, Hlane game drives, and craft market guides in the Ezulwini Valley.
planningTip: Time your visit with the Umhlanga Reed Dance (August–September) or Incwala ceremony for unique cultural experiences.

title: Cape Town & Western Cape tourism
region: Cape Town, Winelands, Garden Route gateway
description: Official Cape Town and Western Cape visitor information — accredited accommodation, tours, and transport in South Africa's most visited province.
planningTip: Book Table Mountain cableway tickets online in peak season — weather closes the upper cable station on high-wind days.

title: iSimangaliso Wetland Park
region: KwaZulu-Natal — St Lucia, Sodwana, Kosi Bay
description: UNESCO World Heritage park — official rest camps, boat safaris, and dive permits for Lake St Lucia, Sodwana Bay, and coastal turtle beaches.
planningTip: Combine with Hluhluwe-iMfolozi and Phinda on a KwaZulu-Natal safari loop — book park activities through the iSimangaliso office.

title: Namibia community conservancies
description: NACSO directory of community-managed conservancies — book conservancy camps and cultural experiences directly with local associations.
planningTip: Conservancy lodges in Torra and Puros offer Himba cultural visits — pay community fees on arrival as directed by the conservancy office.

title: Hospitality Association of Namibia
description: HAN member directory — graded guest farms, lodges, and B&Bs across Namibia with direct booking contacts.
planningTip: Guest farms between Windhoek and Etosha are ideal for self-drive stopovers — many HAN members offer dinner and farm activities.

title: Botswana public reserve camps
description: Department of Wildlife and National Parks public campsites and entry fees for Moremi, CKGR, and northern reserves — book through DWNP offices in Maun and Kasane.
planningTip: Moremi public camps fill quickly in dry season — combine with a licensed operator for Okavango mokoro trips if camps are full.

title: KAZA UniVisa (Zambia & Zimbabwe)
description: Official KAZA UniVisa information for eligible passports — single visa covering Zambia and Zimbabwe for Victoria Falls and Livingstone visits.
planningTip: Buy the KAZA UniVisa on arrival at Livingstone or Victoria Falls airport if eligible — carry USD cash for visa fees.

title: African Parks — Zambia reserves
description: African Parks partnership lodges and park fees for Majete, Liuwa Plain, and Bangweulu — conservation-focused stays with direct booking links.
planningTip: Liuwa Plain wild dog and wildebeest migration is seasonal — check African Parks calendars before booking remote bush camps.

title: Victoria Falls National Park
description: Zimparks Victoria Falls entry, rainforest walk permits, and official park accommodation options on the Zimbabwe side of the falls.
planningTip: Visit both Zambia and Zimbabwe sides of the falls on separate days — KAZA UniVisa covers cross-border day trips for eligible passports.

title: INATUR — Mozambique National Tourism Institute
description: National tourism institute listing registered operators, hotels, and dive centres — official starting point for Tofo, Bazaruto, and Maputo bookings.
planningTip: Confirm e-visa approval before booking non-refundable island lodges — INATUR lists registered operators only.

title: Majete Wildlife Reserve
description: African Parks Majete — restored Big Five reserve with Mkulumadzi Lodge and community tourism programmes in southern Malawi.
planningTip: Combine Majete with Liwonde and Lake Malawi on a southern Malawi loop — reserve gates are cashless; pay park fees online where offered.

title: Lesotho Highlands lodges & Katse Dam
description: Lesotho Highlands Development Authority visitor centres, dam tours, and highlands accommodation near Katse and Mohale dams.
planningTip: Katse Dam wall tours require advance booking through LHDA — combine with Afriski or Sani Pass for a highlands week.

title: Mantenga Cultural Village
description: Big Game Parks cultural village — traditional Swazi dance performances, craft markets, and guided cultural tours in the Ezulwini Valley.
planningTip: Pair Mantenga with Hlane Royal National Park for a full day — morning game drive, afternoon cultural show.

title: Ezemvelo KZN Wildlife parks
description: Official bookings for KwaZulu-Natal provincial parks — Hluhluwe-iMfolozi Big Five safaris, Royal Natal Drakensberg hikes, and Maputaland coastal reserves.
planningTip: Combine Hluhluwe-iMfolozi with iSimangaliso and Phinda on a KZN safari loop — Ezemvelo camps book out fast in school holidays.

title: Timbavati Private Nature Reserve lodges
region: Greater Kruger — unfenced with Kruger NP
description: Official lodge directory for Timbavati — 18 accredited safari lodges and camps on private land sharing an open boundary with Kruger National Park.
planningTip: Timbavati lodges include meals and guided drives in nightly rates — compare with SANParks self-drive camps for budget Kruger options.

title: Thornybush Private Nature Reserve
description: Private reserve lodge collection bordering Kruger — official camp and lodge bookings for Thornybush, including family-friendly and luxury options.
planningTip: Hoedspruit airport (HDS) serves Thornybush fly-in guests — self-drivers can enter via Orpen or Hoedspruit gates with lodge transfer arrangements.

title: Mpumalanga Tourism & Parks Agency
region: Kruger Lowveld, Blyde River Canyon, Manyeleti
description: Official Mpumalanga destination portal and provincial park network — Manyeleti Big Five reserve, Blyde River Canyon, and Kruger gateway towns.
planningTip: Manyeleti shares unfenced boundaries with Kruger and Sabi Sand — book MTPA camps for a more affordable private-reserve experience.

title: Eastern Cape Parks & Tourism Agency
description: Provincial park accommodation and activity bookings — Addo Elephant National Park surrounds, Baviaanskloof wilderness, and Wild Coast nature reserves.
planningTip: Addo is malaria-free Big Five territory — ideal for families combining Garden Route drives with elephant safaris.

title: Gondwana Collection Namibia
region: Etosha surrounds, Namib Desert, Fish River Canyon
description: Namibia's largest lodge group — 50+ properties from Fish River Canyon to Etosha, Damaraland, and the Namib with direct online booking.
planningTip: Gondwana camps near Etosha and Sesriem fill in peak dry season — book Canyon Village and Namib Desert Lodge early for self-drive loops.

title: HATAB member directory
description: Hospitality and Tourism Association of Botswana — searchable directory of 350+ registered camps, lodges, tour operators, and mobile safari outfits.
planningTip: Use HATAB to verify operator registration before paying deposits — Maun booking office can assist with Okavango camp availability.

title: Lower Zambezi Tourism Association
region: Lower Zambezi National Park & river lodges
description: Collective of Lower Zambezi lodge owners and safari operators — member directory for canoe safaris, river camps, and park-edge concessions.
planningTip: Lower Zambezi lodges are mostly outside the park gate — confirm whether park fees and activities are included in your lodge rate.

title: Livingstone Tourism Association
description: Official Livingstone visitor directory — accredited accommodation, restaurants, and Victoria Falls activities on the Zambian side.
planningTip: Livingstone is the base for the Zambian side of Victoria Falls — pair with KAZA UniVisa for cross-border visits to Zimbabwe.

title: South Luangwa accommodation guide
description: Zambia Tourism Agency South Luangwa listings — bushcamps, walking safari specialists, and lodges in Africa's pioneer walking-safari valley.
planningTip: Peak season (July–October) fills South Luangwa bushcamps months ahead — shoulder season offers excellent game viewing with fewer vehicles.

title: Gonarezhou National Park
description: Official Gonarezhou National Park portal — remote wilderness camps, Chilojo Cliffs, and Great Limpopo Transfrontier links with Kruger and Limpopo.
planningTip: Gonarezhou is remote 4x4 country — carry extra fuel and water; combine with Kruger via the Pafuri border for a transfrontier loop.

title: Gorongosa National Park
description: Official Gorongosa tourism portal — park lodges, safari drives, and Mount Gorongosa rainforest hikes in Africa's leading restoration project.
planningTip: Gorongosa suits a central Mozambique loop with Beira or Vilanculos — pre-book accommodation and activities through the park office.

title: Malawi Tourism accommodation
description: Official Malawi Tourism accommodation directory — lakefront lodges, Liwonde safari camps, Nyika Plateau stays, and Mount Mulanje trekking bases.
planningTip: Lake Malawi lodges range from backpacker camps to boutique beach stays — Cape Maclear and Nkhata Bay are popular lake bases.

title: Afriski Mountain Resort
description: Official Afriski bookings — Southern Africa's highest ski and mountain-bike resort in the Maluti Mountains, accessible via the Moteng Pass from South Africa.
planningTip: Winter ski season (June–August) requires 4x4 access after snow — book chalets early for long weekends from Gauteng.

title: Malealea Lodge & pony trekking
description: Community-owned Malealea Lodge — multi-day pony treks, village homestays, and mountain hikes in western Lesotho's highlands.
planningTip: Malealea is a popular stop between Maseru and Sani Pass — book pony treks a day ahead through the lodge office.

title: Eswatini accommodation directory
region: Ezulwini Valley, Mbabane, Lubombo, wildlife reserves
description: Official Eswatini Tourism Authority accommodation filter — searchable directory of hotels, lodges, guest houses, and camps by region and price band.
planningTip: Download the 2026 Accommodation & Tourism Directory PDF from the official site for offline lodge contacts when driving between reserves.

title: Ngwenya Glass Factory
description: Watch master blowers craft recycled-glass animals and vases — one of Africa's oldest glass factories, popular stop between Oshoek border and Ezulwini.
planningTip: Combine with Mantenga Cultural Village for a half-day from Mbabane — cash for the factory shop.

title: Swazi Trails — adventure & transfers
description: Licensed adventure operator — white-water rafting, canopy tours, guided Hlane drives, and airport transfers from JNB via Oshoek border.
planningTip: Book JNB–Ezulwini transfers if skipping a rental car — they handle border timing on busy weekends.

title: All Out Africa — Ezulwini & community tours
description: Day tours to craft markets, community projects, and cultural experiences in the Ezulwini Valley — useful for travellers without self-drive.
planningTip: Pair with a night at Mlilwane or Hlane — Swazi Trails and All Out Africa cover different adventure vs culture niches.

title: Bazaruto Archipelago lodges
description: Gateway lodges and dhow operators for the Bazaruto Marine National Park — book island stays and boat transfers from Vilanculos.
planningTip: Confirm e-visa before booking — most lodges arrange Vilanculos airport or road transfers.

title: Gorongosa National Park — Montebelo
description: Montebelo Gorongosa and park-managed camps in Mozambique's restored wilderness — lion, elephant, and endemic antelope recovery.
planningTip: Dry season May–Nov best for wildlife; fly Beira or self-drive from Vilanculos on long loops.

title: Tofo & Inhambane dive operators
description: Licensed dive centres on the Inhambane peninsula — whale shark snorkel trips (Oct–Mar), manta rays, and Open Water courses.
planningTip: Seasonal whale shark presence varies — book multiple ocean days if snorkelling is your main goal.

title: Maputo Special Reserve & Ponta
description: ANAC-managed coastal reserve south of Maputo — elephant, hippo, and beach camps near the South Africa border at Kosi Bay.
planningTip: Combine with Kosi Bay (SA) on a KZN–Maputo loop — 4x4 recommended inside the reserve.

title: Blue Zebra Island Lodge
description: Private island lodge on Lake Malawi National Park — kayaking, snorkelling cichlids, and boat transfers from Salima.
planningTip: Book boat transfer times when reserving — last boats leave mainland by late afternoon.

title: Robin Pope Safaris — Malawi
description: Premier Malawi safari operator — Mkulumadzi (Liwonde), Nkhotakota relocation project, and bush camps with walking safaris.
planningTip: Mkulumadzi pairs well with Cape Maclear lake days — allow 3 nights minimum in Liwonde.

title: Kutenga Safari & Lake Tours
description: Local operator for Lilongwe transfers, Liwonde boat safaris, and custom lake–bush combinations at mid-range prices.
planningTip: Compare Kutenga with lodge-direct bookings — operators handle park fees and boat timing in one quote.

title: Ngala Beach Lodge — Cape Maclear
description: Beachfront lodge in Cape Maclear — snorkelling the park's cichlid reefs, kayaking, and village cultural walks.
planningTip: Ask locally about bilharzia-safe swimming spots before diving in — conditions vary by bay.

title: Desert & Delta Safaris
description: Established Botswana operator — mobile safaris, Okavango camps, and Chobe river cruises with direct lodge bookings.
planningTip: Mobile camps move with wildlife — confirm seasonal camp locations when comparing quotes.

title: Belmond Savute Elephant Lodge
description: Premium lodge in Chobe with river-facing suites — pairs with Victoria Falls and Kasane day trips.
planningTip: Combine with Kasane self-drive or charter flights from Maun for delta–Chobe loops.

title: Wilderness — Botswana camps
description: Wilderness portfolio across Botswana — Jao, Mombo, DumaTau, and Kalahari Plains with conservation levies included.
planningTip: Book via official site or trusted agent — peak season (Jul–Oct) sells out 12+ months ahead.

title: Shearwater Victoria Falls activities
description: Official activities operator at Victoria Falls — helicopter flights, rafting, bungee, and sunset cruises on the Zambezi.
planningTip: Rafting season depends on Zambezi water levels — low-water runs (Aug–Dec) are most dramatic.

title: African Albida — Hwange lodges
description: Family-friendly lodges at Hwange waterholes — Nehimba and Ivory with guided drives and hide viewing.
planningTip: Dry season (Jul–Oct) concentrates elephants at pumped waterholes — book hide sessions at check-in.

title: Zimparks national park lodges
description: Zimbabwe Parks and Wildlife Authority accommodation — self-catering chalets and campsites in flagship reserves.
planningTip: Mana Pools walking safaris require accredited guide — park entry alone does not include walking permits.
